ts = pd.Series({pd.Period(p, freq='M').to_timestamp(): v for p,v in rows}).asfreq('MS')
print('n', len(ts), 'start', ts.index.min(), 'end', ts.index.max())
print('annual totals/averages')
print(ts.groupby(ts.index.year).agg(['sum','mean']).to_string())
print('March history:', ts[ts.index.month==3].to_string())
# simple benchmarks
q4_2025 = ts['2025-10':'2025-12'].mean()
q4_ratios=[]
for year in [2024,2025]:
    prevq4 = ts[f'{year-1}-10':f'{year-1}-12'].mean()
    q4_ratios.append(ts[f'{year}-03-01']/prevq4)
print('Q4->Mar ratios', q4_ratios, 'avg', np.mean(q4_ratios), 'apply', np.mean(q4_ratios)*q4_2025)
# trailing year-over-year changes by month for 2025 vs 2024
print('2025/2024 by month ratios')
print((ts['2025-01':'2025-12'].values / ts['2024-01':'2024-12'].values).round(3))
print('avg ratio Jan-Dec', np.mean(ts['2025-01':'2025-12'].values / ts['2024-01':'2024-12'].values))
# Holt-Winters fits
for trend in ['add', None]:
  for damped in ([True, False] if trend else [False]):
    try:
      fit = ExponentialSmoothing(ts, trend=trend, damped_trend=damped, seasonal='add', seasonal_periods=12, initialization_method='estimated').fit(optimized=True)
      fc=fit.forecast(3).iloc[-1]
      print('HW', trend, damped, 'AIC', fit.aic, 'Mar26', fc, 'Jan-Feb-Mar', fit.forecast(3).values)
    except Exception as e: print('HW error', trend,damped,e)
# simple SARIMAX candidates
for order,seas in [((0,1,1),(0,1,1,12)), ((1,0,0),(0,1,1,12)), ((1,1,0),(0,1,1,12)), ((0,1,0),(0,1,0,12))]:
    try:
        res=SARIMAX(ts, order=order, seasonal_order=seas, enforce_stationarity=False, enforce_invertibility=False).fit(disp=False)
        pred=res.get_forecast(3)
        print('SAR', order,seas,'aic',res.aic,'Mar26',pred.predicted_mean.iloc[-1], 'ci',pred.conf_int(alpha=.10).iloc[-1].values)
    except Exception as e: print('sar err',e)
# cross-validated one-step/3-step? leave last 12 fit up to t predict t+3 maybe approximate errors for intervals using methods
# forecast candidates
candidates = {
    'model_xgb':14951.7,
    'q4_seasonal_ratio':np.mean(q4_ratios)*q4_2025,
    'seasonal_naive':ts['2025-03-01'],
    'march_avg_2023_2025':ts[ts.index.month==3].mean(),
    'same_yoy_decay_2025vs2024':ts['2025-03-01']*(ts['2025-12-01']/ts['2024-12-01']),
}
print('candidates')
for k,v in candidates.items(): print(k, v)
print('median candidates', np.median(list(candidates.values())), 'mean excl naive?', np.mean([candidates['model_xgb'], candidates['q4_seasonal_ratio'], candidates['same_yoy_decay_2025vs2024']]))
